issue_context.title: `change_point` agg fails with `IllegalArgumentException` while indexing an array
comments: Changing the `values` or adding/removing buckets can cause the problem to disappear or reappear. So it seems to be very dependent on the specific metric that the change point runs on.

review_comments: For change points of e.g. type non-stationary, the location (`cp`) equals `-1` (there's no location). In that case splitting it for the KS test makes no sense and breaks.

BTW. Would it make sense to define this as a static constant. It feels slightly cleaner since we use the magic number elsewhere and would make the code a bit easier to read, i.e. something like `NO_CHANGE_POINT = -1`.
How do you feel about using `null` for no change point?
Never mind, I went with your suggestion. Replacing it with `null` requires more code changes and testing.
